SECTION 1

First Section

This header only becomes position:fixed once the user scrolls past 40px — the common "sticky navbar on scroll" pattern used by many real themes (WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace, Bootstrap navbars, etc). At scrollY=0 it is position:static.

SECTION 2

Second Section

If a sticky-hide mechanism only checks for position:fixed/sticky ONCE, before any scrolling has happened, it will never see this header in its fixed state and will fail to hide it — so it gets baked into every subsequent scroll-stitch frame.
